news.titleEn: Netanyahu calls for US and Israel to overthrow Iran as Brent crude hits five-month high
news.conclusionEn: Brent crude briefly topped $117 on Friday and settled at $116.72, a five-month high, while WTI closed at $103.27 as fears of renewed US-Iran fighting grew.
news.conclusionZh: 布伦特原油一度突破117美元，收于116.72美元，创五个月新高
news.whyEn: Oil above $100 feeds straight into fuel, freight and inflation, pressuring central banks, consumers and airlines worldwide.
news.whyZh: 油价破百直接推高燃油、运费和通胀，央行、消费者和航空业都承压
news.detailEn: The US is maintaining a naval blockade on Iranian oil exports, and President Trump has left the door open to more strikes on Tehran. Shipping through the Strait of Hormuz remains largely halted, with only a handful of daily transits against a pre-war norm of about 85. Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu has escalated his rhetoric, saying the Iranian regime must be toppled. Traders now treat every headline from the Gulf as a direct price signal, so volatility is likely to stay high into next week.
news.detailZh: 美国维持对伊朗石油出口的海上封锁，特朗普也未排除再度打击伊朗。霍尔木兹海峡航运基本停滞，每日通行船只仅寥寥数艘，战前约为85艘。以色列总理内塔尼亚胡言辞升级，称必须推翻伊朗政权。交易员把海湾地区的每条消息都当作价格信号，下周油价波动可能仍然剧烈。

news.conclusionEn: The Dow fell 652.82 points (1.2%) to 52,215.16 on Friday and the S&P 500 lost 0.5% to 7,623.68, as surging oil prices weighed on most stocks.
news.conclusionZh: 道指周五跌652点（1.2%），标普500跌0.5%，油价飙升拖累股市
news.whyEn: Nearly three in four S&P 500 stocks fell, showing that oil-driven inflation fears are now hitting the broad market, not just tech.
news.whyZh: 标普500近四分之三成分股下跌，油价引发的通胀担忧已扩散到整个市场
news.detailEn: Selling that had hit technology stocks a day earlier rotated into cyclical sectors such as industrials and financials. Energy was the only bright spot, with Chevron up 2.9% and ConocoPhillips up 3.6%. For the week, the S&P 500 slipped 0.5% and the Nasdaq 0.7%, while the small-cap Russell 2000 gained 2%. Next week brings a Federal Reserve decision and earnings from Microsoft, Alphabet and Amazon, which could set the market's direction.
news.detailZh: 前一天集中在科技股的抛售转向工业、金融等周期性板块。能源股是唯一亮点，雪佛龙涨2.9%，康菲石油涨3.6%。本周标普500累计跌0.5%，纳指跌0.7%，小盘股罗素2000反而涨2%。下周美联储议息及微软、谷歌、亚马逊财报将决定市场方向。

news.titleEn: US tech stocks tumble as investors fret over AI spending
news.conclusionEn: The Nasdaq dropped 2.6% on Thursday, its worst day since June, after Meta raised its capex outlook to $135-145 billion and its shares fell nearly 7%.
news.conclusionZh: Meta上调资本开支至1350-1450亿美元，股价跌近7%，纳指单日跌2.6%
news.whyEn: AI spending has powered this bull market; doubts about its returns threaten the stocks that dominate global indexes and retirement funds.
news.whyZh: AI投资是本轮牛市引擎，回报一旦受质疑，权重科技股和养老金都受冲击
news.detailEn: Meta's profit missed expectations even as it lifted spending, reviving fears of a dot-com style bubble. Tesla and Alphabet each fell 3.1%; Tesla had cut its 2026 capex forecast to about $20 billion. The S&P 500 fell 1.2%, its biggest drop since late July. Microsoft, Alphabet and Amazon report next week, giving investors the first hard look at whether hyperscaler AI spending is paying off.
news.detailZh: Meta在加大投入的同时利润不及预期，重新引发对类似互联网泡沫的担忧。特斯拉和谷歌母公司Alphabet均跌3.1%，特斯拉已把2026年资本开支预期下调至约200亿美元。标普500当天跌1.2%，为7月底以来最大跌幅。微软、谷歌、亚马逊下周发布财报，将首次检验云巨头的AI投入是否见到回报。

news.titleEn: U.S. prepares options for potential post-midterm election strikes on Iran
news.conclusionEn: The US military is preparing options for possible strikes on Iranian infrastructure after the Nov. 3 midterm elections, according to reports.
news.conclusionZh: 据报道，美军正准备在11月3日中期选举后打击伊朗基础设施的方案
news.whyEn: Renewed strikes could keep the Strait of Hormuz shut longer, extending the energy shock for importers in Asia and Europe.
news.whyZh: 若再次开打，霍尔木兹海峡关闭时间会更长，亚欧能源进口国冲击加剧
news.detailEn: US officials told The New York Times that Washington and Israel have plans for fresh strikes on Iran once the midterms are over. The reports helped push Brent to its highest level since April. Trump has meanwhile accused Iran of fabricating tanker attacks to lift oil prices before the vote, while Iran's state media claims several vessels were hit near Hormuz. Markets will watch whether diplomacy via Pakistani mediators gains traction before the election.
news.detailZh: 美国官员向《纽约时报》透露，美以已制定中期选举后再度打击伊朗的计划，这一消息推动布伦特油价升至4月以来最高。与此同时，特朗普指责伊朗伪造油轮遇袭消息以在选前抬高油价，伊朗官媒则称霍尔木兹附近多艘船只被击中。市场将关注选前巴基斯坦斡旋的外交渠道能否取得进展。

news.titleEn: Violence flares in Paris after massive, largely peaceful protests across France
news.conclusionEn: More than 400,000 people protested across France on Saturday over school funding and living costs, with clashes in Paris and nearly 1,000 arrests.
news.conclusionZh: 法国超40万人上街抗议教育经费和生活成本，巴黎爆发冲突近千人被捕
news.whyEn: Mounting unrest weakens Macron's ability to pass budget measures and adds political risk to the eurozone's second-largest economy.
news.whyZh: 持续动荡削弱马克龙推动预算的能力，给欧元区第二大经济体增添政治风险
news.detailEn: Authorities deployed 70,000 police and gendarmes, 10,000 more than a week earlier, after admitting they underestimated the Oct. 17 protests. The Paris march was mostly peaceful, but around a thousand people clashed with police, who used tear gas and water cannon. Anti-government demonstrations also spread to Italy, Albania and other European countries. Luxury stores in Paris boarded up windows, a sign the unrest is starting to hit retail and tourism.
news.detailZh: 当局承认低估了10月17日的抗议规模，此次部署7万名警察和宪兵，比一周前多1万人。巴黎游行总体和平，但约千人与警方冲突，警方动用催泪瓦斯和水炮。反政府示威还蔓延到意大利、阿尔巴尼亚等欧洲国家。巴黎奢侈品店纷纷封窗，动荡开始波及零售和旅游业。

news.titleEn: Lindt got chocolate price hikes wrong, chairman says after CEO's ouster
news.conclusionEn: Lindt & Sprüngli's chairman admitted the company misjudged consumer reaction to its price increases, days after ousting CEO Adalbert Lechner.
news.conclusionZh: 瑞士莲董事长承认涨价判断失误，此前公司刚撤换CEO
news.whyEn: It is a clear case of pricing power hitting its limit, a warning for consumer brands passing on high commodity costs.
news.whyZh: 这是定价权触顶的典型案例，给转嫁原料成本的消费品牌敲响警钟
news.detailEn: Lindt raised prices by an average of 11.8% in the first half of 2026 to offset soaring cocoa costs, but sales volumes fell sharply, especially in Germany. The shares have dropped more than 25% this year after two profit warnings. Former CEO Dieter Weisskopf, 71, is back as interim chief, with a permanent successor due in Q2 2027. Investors will watch whether Lindt cuts prices or boosts promotions to win back volume.
news.detailZh: 为抵消可可价格暴涨，瑞士莲2026年上半年平均提价11.8%，但销量大幅下滑，德国市场尤甚。公司一年内两次下调盈利预期，股价今年累计跌超25%。71岁的前CEO魏斯科普夫回归担任临时CEO，正式继任者预计2027年第二季度确定。投资者将关注公司是否降价或加大促销以挽回销量。

news.titleEn: North Korea's Kim Jong Un visits China via newly opened bridge
news.conclusionEn: Kim Jong Un crossed the new Yalu River Bridge into Dandong on Saturday, his first China visit in a year, and was greeted with Xi Jinping's best wishes.
news.conclusionZh: 金正恩经新鸭绿江大桥访问丹东，为一年来首次访华
news.whyEn: Closer Beijing-Pyongyang ties and new trade logistics could weaken sanctions pressure and reshape security in Northeast Asia.
news.whyZh: 中朝关系升温叠加物流改善，可能削弱制裁效果并影响东北亚安全格局
news.detailEn: The 3km bridge, completed in 2014, opened only this month after a 12-year delay. Kim was accompanied by Wang Huning, China's fourth-ranked official, and visited a Korean War memorial and a local auto factory. He said Pyongyang stands ready to expand practical cooperation with China. Analysts expect the bridge to ease logistics bottlenecks and boost bilateral trade.
news.detailZh: 这座3公里长的大桥2014年就已建成，拖延12年后本月才正式开通。中国第四号人物王沪宁陪同金正恩参观了抗美援朝纪念馆和当地汽车工厂。金正恩表示朝方愿与中国扩大务实合作。分析人士预计大桥将缓解物流瓶颈，带动双边贸易增长。

news.titleEn: Russia, Ukraine agree to Oleshky ceasefire brokered by Melania Trump, White House says
news.conclusionEn: Russia and Ukraine agreed to a temporary local ceasefire in the occupied city of Oleshky to allow aid deliveries and civilian evacuations, the White House said.
news.conclusionZh: 白宫称梅拉尼娅促成俄乌在奥列什基临时停火，以便运送援助和撤离平民
news.whyEn: Though small and local, it is a rare working channel between Moscow and Kyiv that could be a template for wider humanitarian deals.
news.whyZh: 规模虽小，却是俄乌间少见的有效沟通渠道，或可推广到更大范围
news.detailEn: A senior Ukrainian official said the ceasefire would begin on Oct. 27; its duration is unclear. Only about 1,700-2,000 mostly elderly residents remain of a pre-war population of around 24,000, amid a deepening food crisis. Non-military teams from both sides will visit residents and arrange evacuation to Russia or Ukraine. Success could build momentum for broader talks, but local ceasefires have collapsed before.
news.detailZh: 乌克兰高级官员称停火将于10月27日开始，持续时间尚不明确。该市战前约2.4万人，如今仅剩1700至2000名居民，多为老人，食品危机日益严重。双方非军事团队将上门探访，并安排居民撤往俄罗斯或乌克兰。若顺利执行，可能为更广泛谈判积累动力，但此前的局部停火也曾破裂。

news.titleEn: At least 7 killed in attack on Jordan church during funeral, authorities say
news.conclusionEn: Gunmen opened fire at a Greek Orthodox church funeral in Karak, Jordan, killing at least seven people and wounding dozens.
news.conclusionZh: 约旦卡拉克一东正教堂葬礼遭枪手袭击，至少7人死亡数十人受伤
news.whyEn: Jordan is a key US ally and regional stabilizer; a terror attack there raises fears of the Iran war's instability spreading.
news.whyZh: 约旦是美国重要盟友和地区稳定器，恐袭加剧外界对战火外溢的担忧
news.detailEn: State TV footage showed three gunmen, one with a semiautomatic rifle, approaching and firing at the church about 180km south of Amman. The government said the attack was carried out by unknown assailants and that investigations are underway. King Abdullah II called it a terrorist act and vowed the harshest penalties. Further security tightening and impacts on tourism are likely.
news.detailZh: 官方电视画面显示，三名枪手（其中一人持半自动步枪）在距安曼约180公里的教堂外开枪。政府称袭击者身份不明，调查正全速进行。国王阿卜杜拉二世称之为恐怖行为，誓言严惩。约旦可能进一步收紧安保，旅游业或受影响。

businessTips.explanationEn: Pricing power is a company's ability to raise prices without losing many customers. It depends on brand strength, switching costs and how essential the product is. Warren Buffett calls it the single most important factor in evaluating a business. But it has limits, and testing them too aggressively can destroy volume and trust.
businessTips.explanationZh: 定价权是指企业提价后不会流失太多客户的能力，取决于品牌力、转换成本以及产品是否刚需。巴菲特认为这是评估一家企业最重要的因素。但定价权有上限，过度试探会损失销量和信任。
businessTips.exampleEn: Lindt raised chocolate prices nearly 12% to offset cocoa costs, assuming loyal buyers would stay, but volumes fell sharply and the CEO lost his job. Smarter brands raise prices in smaller steps, or offer a cheaper tier so price-sensitive shoppers don't leave entirely.
businessTips.exampleZh: 瑞士莲为抵消可可成本提价近12%，以为忠实客户不会走，结果销量大跌，CEO也被撤换。更聪明的做法是小步提价，或推出低价版本，让价格敏感的顾客不至于完全流失。

businessTips.explanationEn: Grandfathering means keeping existing customers on their old price when you raise prices for new customers. It rewards early supporters, reduces churn and lets you test higher prices with less risk. It also creates urgency, since new buyers know prices only go up.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「老价锁定」是指对新客户涨价时，老客户继续享受原价。这样既回馈早期支持者、降低流失，又能低风险地测试更高价格。同时也制造紧迫感，因为新客户知道价格只会越来越高。
businessTips.exampleEn: A freelancer selling a $15/month template membership raises the price to $25 for new sign-ups but tells current members their $15 rate is locked for life. Sign-ups spike before the change, and existing members stay because leaving means losing their deal.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位自由职业者的模板会员原价每月15美元，对新用户涨到25美元，同时告诉老会员15美元终身不变。涨价前注册量激增，老会员也不愿退订，因为一走就失去优惠价。

businessTips.explanationEn: Stagflation is the combination of high inflation and slowing economic growth, often triggered by a supply shock like a spike in oil prices. It is hard for central banks because raising rates fights inflation but hurts growth further. Stocks and bonds can fall together, so traditional diversification works less well.
businessTips.explanationZh: 滞胀是指高通胀与经济放缓同时出现，常由油价暴涨等供给冲击引发。央行左右为难：加息能抑制通胀，却会进一步拖累增长。股票和债券可能同时下跌，传统的分散配置效果变差。
businessTips.exampleEn: The 1970s oil shocks pushed US inflation above 10% while unemployment rose. Today, with Brent above $116 and the Fed weighing more hikes, investors are watching for stagflation and often rotate toward energy stocks, commodities and inflation-protected bonds.
businessTips.exampleZh: 上世纪70年代石油危机让美国通胀超过10%，失业率同时上升。如今布伦特油价超116美元、美联储考虑继续加息，投资者警惕滞胀，常转向能源股、大宗商品和通胀保值债券。
